first energy_bound violation: energy jumps ~6x in one step with no controller work

counterfactual.change: reduced body 0 vx from 42.03 to 5.0 (lower closing speed) keeping all else identical; collision no longer creates energy and no rule is violated

explanation: High-speed oblique circle-circle collision creates energy and momentum. Initial x-momentum ~-229.5 becomes ~+798.9 and y-momentum 0 becomes ~-402, with energy 3712->23651J in one step (6 substeps) and zero controller work, with bodies ending overlapped (gap -0.00088). Likely the impulse/positional-correction path over-applies (e.g. repeated or mass-swapped normal impulse, plus normal with large y-component from dy=0.7 offset) at high closing speed (~58 m/s) and large mass ratio (~16.6:1), injecting momentum along the contact normal into the heavy body (vx -16.3->+45.75, vy 0->-24.29) instead of conserving it.
vision_note: The two blue circles in the lower right start just apart and then press together into touching overlap at step 1. They remain interpenetrated in contact instead of separating cleanly after the impact.
